#!/usr/bin/env python3
# Solution for Task ID: T12
# Reads outputs/t11_city_indicator_matrix.csv and writes two result files.

import os
import csv
import pandas as pd

def main():
    input_path = os.path.join("outputs", "t11_city_indicator_matrix.csv")
    df = pd.read_csv(input_path, dtype=str)  # read all columns as string to preserve missingness

    # Identify indicator columns (exclude city_id, city_name, year)
    id_cols = {"city_id", "city_name", "year"}
    indicator_cols = [col for col in df.columns if col not in id_cols]

    n_rows = len(df)

    # Compute missingness
    missing_counts = {}
    missing_rates = {}
    keep_flags = {}
    for col in indicator_cols:
        missing = df[col].isna().sum()
        missing_counts[col] = missing
        missing_rate = missing / n_rows
        missing_rates[col] = missing_rate
        keep_flags[col] = missing_rate <= 0.30

    # Write missingness report
    miss_report_path = os.path.join("outputs", "t12_missingness_report.csv")
    with open(miss_report_path, "w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        writer = csv.writer(f, quoting=csv.QUOTE_MINIMAL)
        writer.writerow(["indicator", "missing_count", "missing_rate", "kept"])
        for col in indicator_cols:
            writer.writerow([
                col,
                missing_counts[col],
                f"{missing_rates[col]:.6f}",
                "True" if keep_flags[col] else "False"
            ])

    # Prepare selected matrix
    kept_cols = ["city_id", "city_name", "year"] + [c for c in indicator_cols if keep_flags[c]]
    selected_matrix_path = os.path.join("outputs", "t12_selected_matrix.csv")
    df_selected = df[kept_cols]
    df_selected.to_csv(selected_matrix_path, quoting=csv.QUOTE_MINIMAL, index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
</solution_file>
